description: footRoll 50 over a break of 30: the ball takes 30 and the toe tip 20. The ball is last in the chain, so it turns the ankle first: +30 about (0, 0, 10), offset (8, -16) gives y = 8 cos30 + 16 sin30 = 14.928203, z = 10 + 8 sin30 - 16 cos30 = 0.143594. Then the toe tip turns that +20 about (0, 0, 18), offset (14.928203, -17.856406): y = 20.135173, z = 18 - 11.673787 = 6.326213. The toe tip stays on the ground. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target: (4, 4, 0) + 0.1 * (P - (0, 8, -6)).
